title: Provenance and research-object interoperability — agent-panel evaluation

panel_protocol.limitation: Source-verified and fixture-proven implementation only; golden provenance export tests, independent RO-Crate 1.3 validation tooling, and live OSF/Zenodo repository deposit remain gated.

inter_rater_agreement.agreement_notes: All three panel roles converged independently on approval. Convergence centered on: (1) RO-Crate 1.3 JSON-LD profile topology, root CreativeWork and Dataset entities, provider deduplication, and Person vs SoftwareApplication actor differentiation; (2) W3C PROV-O entity/activity/agent vocabulary, stepwise wasDerivedFrom derivation chains, and fail-closed validation on unresolved predecessors or review ID mismatches; (3) deterministic sorting of receipts and events guaranteeing bitwise identical export documents regardless of input slice order; (4) deterministic .srpack review bundle packaging with fixed timestamps, Merkle descriptor root, and SHA-256 payload verification; (5) strict schema-enforced prohibition of automated deposit ('deposit_authorized: false', 'osf_acceptance_claimed: false', 'execution_mode: dry_run'); and (6) rigorous preservation of open maturity gates (golden provenance export tests, independent RO-Crate CLI validation, and live repository deposit pilots).
convergence_vectors: CreativeWork descriptor ('ro-crate-metadata.json') and root Dataset ('./') linking receipts via hasPart and review via mainEntity
Actor type mapping cleanly distinguishing human researchers ('Person') from automated agents ('SoftwareApplication')
W3C PROV-O entity, activity, agent, wasAssociatedWith, and wasDerivedFrom derivation structures
Fail-closed validation with ProvenanceError::UnresolvedPredecessor, ReviewMismatch, and DuplicateIdentifier
Determinism invariants guaranteeing bitwise identical bundles and PROV/RO-Crate exports across input permutations
Review bundle .srpack packaging with Merkle root descriptor digests, SHA-256 payload integrity, and secret rejection
Default-deny handoff plan schema enforcing dry_run execution and prohibiting unapproved external repository writes
divergence_vectors: Slice completeness in long-running audit event log streams versus pagination boundaries in wasDerivedFrom resolution
Adoption of ro-crate-py vs native rust-based RO-Crate validator for future CI profile checking

assertions_evaluated.notes: Immutable identifiers, SHA-256 event hashes, descriptor Merkle root calculations, and fail-closed predecessor validation (ProvenanceError::UnresolvedPredecessor) verified by unit tests, export_edges.rs, provenance_interop_scenarios.rs, and review_bundle.py self-test; durable institutional PIDs preserved as open gate.

Review, run, receipt, audit event, actor, amendment, and decision entities modeled in RO-Crate and W3C PROV representations, verified by test_prov_entities_activities_agents_predecessors and test_ro_crate_schema_and_context; full entity round-trips preserved as open gate.

RO-Crate 1.3 JSON-LD profile context (https://w3id.org/ro/crate/1.3/context), root CreativeWork, root Dataset with hasPart receipts and mainEntity ScholarlyArticle verified in searchright-provenance and test_provenance_research_objects_governance.py; formal validation with external RO-Crate CLI tooling preserved as open gate.

W3C PROV entity, activity, agent, wasAssociatedWith, and wasDerivedFrom predecessor derivation chains verified in searchright-provenance and test_w3c_prov_derivation_chain_and_entities; external semantic validator remains an open gate.

Repository handoff plan schema (research-object-handoff-plan.v1.schema.json) and review bundle packaging (review_bundle.py) verified; strict schema constants enforce execution_mode: 'dry_run', deposit_authorized: false, and osf_acceptance_claimed: false, prohibiting automatic deposit.

Round-trip determinism, bitwise byte identity across input permutations, example.srpack bundle verification, tamper rejection, and secret rejection verified by cargo test (20 tests passed) and review_bundle.py self-test; external golden round trips preserved as open gate.

panel_recommendations: Retain explicit lexical sorting of receipts and audit events to guarantee bitwise reproducibility across platforms.
Preserve schema-level const: false enforcement for deposit_authorized, ro_crate_conformance_claimed, and osf_acceptance_claimed in repository handoff plans.
Maintain honest claim boundaries distinguishing source-verified provenance and review bundles from independent RO-Crate CLI validation and live repository deposit.
open_gates: Compile and run golden provenance export tests.
Validate produced RO-Crates with independent tooling.
Pilot OSF/Zenodo/repository deposit without automatic write authority.
